test_image_augmentation_functions: test the dm_pix augment module image augmentation functions against TensorFlow reference implementations
run_augment_test_suite: run the absltest-based test suite for brightness, contrast, gamma, saturation, hue, flip, and crop augmentations
test_color_adjustment_augments: test adjust_brightness, adjust_contrast, adjust_gamma, adjust_saturation, and adjust_hue against tf.image equivalents
test_geometric_augments: test rot90, flip_left_right, flip_up_down, affine_transform, and rotate against scipy and TensorFlow references
